power.friend_races.orca_swimmer.name: Ocean Stride
power.friend_races.orca_lungs.name: Mammalian Lungs
power.friend_races.orca_lungs.descriptio: +6 oxygen bonus: approximately 105 seconds until air bubbles deplete.
power.friend_races.orca_hunter.name: Underwater Hunter
power.friend_races.orca_hunter.descripti: +1 melee attack-damage while your body is completely underwater.
power.friend_races.orca_mass.name: Heavy Build
power.friend_races.orca_mass.description: +0.15 knockback resistance everywhere. Another +0.15 while you are completely submerged underwater.
power.friend_races.orca_vision.name: Deep Sight
power.friend_races.orca_vision.descripti: Gain night vision while your eyes are underwater.
power.friend_races.orca_echo.name: Echolocation
power.friend_races.orca_echo.description: While submerged, reveal hostile creatures within 48 blocks for 8 seconds and nearby sea life for 5 seconds, through walls. On land, only hostiles within 16 blocks. 30-second cooldown; costs 40 Sea Reserve. Highlighted creatures are visible to everyone.
power.friend_races.orca_reserve.name: Sea Reserve
power.friend_races.orca_reserve.descript: 600-point reserve that fuels Echolocation and Pod Call. Out of water: lose 2 per second (empty in about 5 minutes). In water: no loss. Fully submerged or in rain: regain 5 per second below 150, 10 per second below 300, and 15 per second above that. At 300 or less, hunger drains x1.20 faster. At 150 or less, natural healing is halved. At 0 while dry, movement speed x0.85.
power.friend_races.orca_heat.name: Heat Sensitivity
power.friend_races.orca_heat.description: Take x1.20 damage from all sources of fire.
power.friend_races.orca_aqua_affinity.de: Mine blocks underwater at normal speed, unaffected by the usual underwater mining penalty.
power.friend_races.orca_diet.name: Piscivore
power.friend_races.orca_diet.description: You can only eat fish. Raw fish restores 6-7 food points and cooked fish keeps you saturated for longer.
power.friend_races.orca_pod_call.name: Pod Call
power.friend_races.orca_pod_call.descrip: While submerged, give nearby players (12 blocks) Dolphin's Grace for 10 seconds and Water Breathing for 30 seconds. 90-second cooldown; costs 60 Sea Reserve.
power.friend_races.orca_size.name: Biggest Dolphin
power.friend_races.orca_size.description: You are 130% normal size with normal reach.
power.friend_races.orca_breach.name: Breach
power.friend_races.orca_breach.descripti: While sprint-swimming, press Hotkey 01 (bind to Space in Controls) to leap forward out of the water. 4-second cooldown.
power.friend_races.orca_heavy_landing.de: Take 20% more fall damage, and fall damage is halved for 4 seconds after a Breach.
power.friend_races.orca_apex.name: Apex Predator
power.friend_races.orca_apex.description: Hitting fish and other prey has a 50% chance to restore 1 food point.
power.friend_races.orca_shark_bane.name: Shark's Bane
power.friend_races.orca_shark_bane.descr: Great white sharks flee from you and won't attack.
power.friend_races.orca_ray_hunter.name: Ray Hunter
power.friend_races.watermelon_rind.name: Firm Rind
power.friend_races.watermelon_pantry.des: Eating a melon slice restores 4 food points instead of 2. Saturation also scales proportionally (2.4 instead of 1.2).
power.friend_races.watermelon_sun.name: Sun Power
power.friend_races.watermelon_sun.descri: Gain 1 sunlight per second in direct sunlight, up to 120. Sunlight fuels Rolling Start and Summer Glow.
power.friend_races.watermelon_share.name: Share the Harvest
power.friend_races.watermelon_share.desc: Heal every player within 6 blocks, including yourself, for 4 HP. Costs 30 sunlight and 2 food/saturation points. 60-second cooldown.
power.friend_races.watermelon_slow.name: Round Stride
power.friend_races.watermelon_fire.name: Roasted Rind
power.friend_races.watermelon_fire.descr: Take x1.25 damage from fire sources.
power.friend_races.watermelon_glow.name: Summer Glow
power.friend_races.watermelon_glow.descr: Toggle: every 4 seconds, heal each player within 6 blocks, including yourself, for 1 HP. Each pulse costs 5 sunlight and turns off automatically when sunlight runs out.
power.friend_races.watermelon_photosynth: While in direct sunlight with a full sunlight bar, restore 1 hunger every 30 seconds.
power.friend_races.watermelon_roll.name: Rolling Start
power.friend_races.watermelon_roll.descr: Sprinting builds momentum (full after about 12 seconds) that fades when you stop. With momentum, sprint speed rises up to x1.40 (x1.10, then x1.20, then x1.40 at top speed). Top speed costs 4 sunlight per second. Fall damage while rolling increases to x1.25 at half momentum and x1.50 near full.
power.friend_races.shy_guy_soles.name: Soft Soles
power.friend_races.shy_guy_tumble.name: Practiced Tumble
power.friend_races.shy_guy_exit.name: Stage Exit
power.friend_races.shy_guy_exit.descript: For 6 seconds, movement speed x1.25 but your attacks deal x0.75 damage. 30-second cooldown; costs 2 food points.
power.friend_races.shy_guy_small.name: Small Fry
power.friend_races.shy_guy_small.descrip: You are 80% normal size with normal reach, and have 18 maximum HP.
power.friend_races.shy_guy_crowd.name: Safety in Numbers
power.friend_races.shy_guy_crowd.descrip: Braver with company: melee damage x1.15 when another player is within 10 blocks.
power.friend_races.shy_guy_turnip.name: Turnip Toss
power.friend_races.shy_guy_turnip.descri: Throw a turnip that deals 6 damage where it lands. 4-second cooldown.
Invisible while sneaking, armor and held items included. Attacking or taking damage reveals you for 3 seconds.
power.friend_races.shy_guy_arachnophobia: Take x1.50 melee damage while a spider is within 3 blocks.
Movement speed x1.35 while a spider is within 8 blocks.
power.friend_races.knight_health.name: Conditioned Veteran
power.friend_races.knight_training.name: Armor Training
power.friend_races.knight_training.descr: +2 armor toughness while total armor is at least 8.
power.friend_races.knight_poise.name: Steady Footing
power.friend_races.knight_brace.name: Hold the Line
power.friend_races.knight_brace.descript: A 4-second stance: while grounded, unmounted and at 8+ armor, take x0.85 incoming damage, gain +0.35 knockback resistance and move at x0.65 speed. 10-second cooldown; costs 2 food points.
power.friend_races.knight_swim.name: Heavy Swimmer
power.friend_races.knight_shield.name: Shield Discipline
power.friend_races.knight_shield.descrip: While holding a shield in your offhand, melee hits apply Slowness I to the target for 1.5 seconds.
power.friend_races.knight_oath.name: Sworn Oath
power.friend_races.knight_counter.name: Guard Counter
power.friend_races.knight_counter.descri: Taking a hit during Hold the Line opens a 2-second window where your next melee hit deals x1.30 damage.
power.friend_races.human_practical.name: Practical Hands
power.friend_races.human_practical.descr: Block-breaking speed x1.10 with all tools.
power.friend_races.human_ration.name: Paced Effort
power.friend_races.human_ration.descript: Exhaustion from actions like running or jumping reduced to x0.90.
power.friend_races.human_repair.name: Maintenance Habit
power.friend_races.human_focus.name: Choose Your Effort
power.friend_races.human_focus.descripti: Sneak-activate for a 20-second work burst (block-breaking speed x1.35, movement speed x0.90), or activate normally for a 20-second travel burst (movement speed x1.15, no mining bonus). Afterward, suffer 10 seconds of x0.90 movement and attack speed. 60-second cooldown; costs 2 food/saturation points.
power.friend_races.human_concentration.d: The work burst slows movement to x0.90.
power.friend_races.human_fatigue.name: Recovery Fatigue
power.friend_races.human_fatigue.descrip: After either burst, suffer 10 seconds of x0.90 movement and attack speed.
power.friend_races.human_study.name: Quick Study
power.friend_races.human_attunement.name: Quick Learner's Mind
power.friend_races.human_attunement.desc: Mana for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks regenerates x1.10.
origins.friend_races.orca.name: Orca
origins.friend_races.orca.description: An aquatic hunter with powerful swimming, finite breath and cooperative sonar. Dry expeditions demand preparation.
origins.friend_races.watermelon.name: Watermelon
origins.friend_races.watermelon.descript: A sturdy character who photosynthesizes food and health, and stores sunlight for group healing. Makes melon slices a real meal.
origins.friend_races.shy_guy.name: Shy Guy
origins.friend_races.shy_guy.description: A small, masked fiend: timid alone, bold in a crowd. Slips out of sight, tosses turnips, and bolts at the first sign of trouble, especially spiders.
origins.friend_races.knight.name: Knight
origins.friend_races.knight.description: A grounded frontliner who times a defensive stand, with sturdy health and armor training, at the cost of a bigger appetite and heavier swimming.
origins.friend_races.human.name: Human
origins.friend_races.human.description: A normal, adaptable expedition member. Practical skills and good provisions suit any path, including Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks magic; deliberate exertion gives flexible short bursts.
